tasks.title: CLP/JPY/KWD amounts rendered with the wrong number of decimals
tasks.summary: Fixed Amount.Decimal to use the currency exponent: CLP/JPY render without decimals, KWD with three, and USD retains two. Preserved negative signs safely across the full int64 range. Added money and API regression tests covering create, get, list, fees, refunds, and remaining amounts. go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt checks pass.

tasks.title: Multiple partial refunds can exceed the captured amount
tasks.summary: Fixed refund validation to compare against the remaining balance instead of the original payment amount. Added service and API regressions covering cumulative over-refunds, unchanged payment state and no events on rejection, exact-remainder transition to REFUNDED, and concurrent refund safety. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt.

tasks.title: Cursor pagination silently drops one payment per page
tasks.summary: Fixed pagination's off-by-one: cursors now resume directly at the next unread payment instead of skipping it. Made page-end calculation overflow-safe. Added repository and HTTP regression tests covering creation order, merchant isolation, limit=1, 1,000-payment walks, and empty final cursors for exact and partial pages. go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt checks pass.

tasks.title: Webhook dispatcher retries permanent 4xx failures and gives up on 5xx
tasks.summary: Fixed webhook retry classification to retry transport errors, 408, 429, and 5xx only, matching the README. Added regression tests for permanent failures, recovery, capped backoff, retry exhaustion, and dead-letter attempt counts and last statuses. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt.

tasks.title: Idempotency keys never expire after 24h
tasks.summary: Fixed idempotency expiry to use now >= ExpiresAt, removing the extra-TTL retention. Begin now evicts an expired requested key even when the periodic purge is not due. Added regression tests for exact-boundary expiry, unchanged pre-expiry behavior, memory eviction, concurrent Begin calls, and payment creation after 24/40 hours. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt -l .

tasks.title: Every client error is returned as 500 internal_error
tasks.summary: Fixed API error classification using errors.Is so domain errors retain documented statuses and codes through arbitrary wrapping. Unexpected errors still return 500 internal_error with a generic message. Added regression tests for all existing domain mappings, nested/joined errors, affected endpoints, and idempotent error replay. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt -l . pass.

tasks.title: Late webhook retries fire with no delay
tasks.summary: Fixed webhook backoff overflow by checking MaxDelay before each doubling, preserving positive, nondecreasing, capped delays for positive policies even at extreme attempt numbers. Added duration-boundary tests and a 48-attempt enterprise dispatcher regression test. Validated with go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt -l .; all passed.

tasks.title: Add payment cancellation (CANCELED status + endpoint + webhook)
tasks.summary: Implemented final StatusCanceled, case-insensitive parsing, Service.Cancel from CREATED/PENDING, and POST /payments/{id}/cancel using existing error mapping and webhook publishing. Added lifecycle, HTTP, and webhook-delivery tests plus documentation. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt -l . all pass.

tasks.title: Filter the merchant payment listing by status
tasks.summary: Implemented optional case-insensitive status filtering for payment listings, with 400 invalid_request for invalid statuses. Repository pagination now fills pages from matching payments in creation order and emits a cursor only when another match exists; unfiltered behavior is preserved. Added API/store regression tests and documentation. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt -l .

tasks.title: Replay a dead-lettered webhook event
tasks.summary: Implemented Dispatcher.Replay with ErrDeadLetterNotFound, preserved event IDs/payloads, normal retries and fresh signatures, atomic dead-letter removal, and cancellation recovery. Added POST /webhooks/dead-letters/{eventID}/replay with 200 delivery results and 404 not_found mapping. Added dispatcher and HTTP regression tests. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt -l . all pass.

tasks.title: Accept and return integer minor units, backward compatible
tasks.summary: Added integer minor-unit inputs for payments and refunds with strict type/presence validation and dual-format equality checks. Preserved legacy decimal fields and added minor-unit fields to all payment/refund responses. Normalization preserves cross-format idempotency. Added validation, currency, endpoint, and replay tests and updated documentation. go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt checks pass.

tasks.title: Centralize the payment status machine in one transition table
tasks.summary: Added payment.CanTransition as the single source of allowed transitions and refactored Authorize, Capture, Decline, and Refund to use it, preserving validation order, errors, events, and partial-refund behavior. Added exhaustive transition and service matrix tests. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt.

tasks.title: Idempotency store is not safe under concurrent retries
tasks.summary: Made idempotency.Memory concurrency-safe by holding its mutex across Begin's check-and-reserve operation and all Complete/Release record access, including response copying. Preserved public APIs and expiry semantics. Added concurrent regression tests for single-winner retries, completion/replay, expired and released keys, and lifecycle operations during purging. Passed go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt checks.

tasks.title: In-memory repository shares mutable state with callers
tasks.summary: Fixed Memory repository aliasing by using Payment.Clone on all input/output boundaries while preserving optimistic locking. Documented repository isolation and added regression tests for mutable-state isolation, failed-update rollback, and concurrent refunds. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt.

tasks.title: Idempotency Begin gets slower with every stored key
tasks.summary: Removed per-request sorting and scanning from Begin. Expired records are now swept without allocation at most once per minute, while each requested key is checked for expiry on every lookup. Added expiry, periodic eviction, concurrency regression tests, and a live-key scaling benchmark. Verified go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt -l . all pass.

tasks.title: Split payouts do not reconcile with the charged amount
tasks.summary: Fixed money.Allocate using exact integer largest-remainder allocation: payouts sum to the charge, with leftover units assigned by fractional remainder and lower-index ties. Handles large amounts and ratio sums without overflow, preserves currency and inputs, and keeps the public API unchanged. Added regression and randomized contract tests. go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt checks all pass.

tasks.title: Identical retries rejected as idempotency key reuse
tasks.summary: Replaced raw-body idempotency fingerprints with canonical parsed inputs: exact merchant ID, amount in minor units, and normalized currency. Payment creation and refund retries now replay original responses despite JSON formatting or equivalent money representations, while genuinely different requests remain rejected. Added regression coverage for replay, duplicate prevention, validation, errors, currency precision, and key scoping. go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt checks pass.

tasks.title: Processing fees overcharged by one cent
tasks.summary: Fixed money.Fee to use overflow-safe exact integer arithmetic and half-to-even rounding, preserving validation and currency. Added regression tests for the reported overcharge, tie rounding, currency exponents, invalid inputs, and every supported rate at precision boundaries through MaxInt64. go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and gofmt checks all pass.
